verdict.rationale: Gitleaks documents a baseline mode: when the `--baseline-path` parameter is used, old findings in the baseline are ignored and the report contains only new issues. Per-rule allowlists suppress false positives, and a finding is ignored if any allowlist matches. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the baseline and allowlist workflows, and evidence of per-finding ignore mechanisms such as fingerprint ignore files or inline suppression comments.
